Export DataAccess APIMetadata Portal Metadata InformationContent TitleDam Safety NSW Notification AreaContent TypeHosted Feature LayerDescriptionA dam notification area is an area that underlies or surrounds the wall of a declared dam. It is defined by straight lines joining a series of coordinates. Coverage: Spatial Services (DCS). The portal lists 3 near-identical datasets in this series (one per year, month, area or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher Spatial Services (DCS). Its tags are Dam, Dam Safety, Safety, Water. It offers 1 resource(s) in ARCGIS REST SERVICE. The portal shows 2025-11-13 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support flood defence and reservoir studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
